match.hint.empty_query: Enter a material or work description to search the cost database.
match.hint.no_candidates: No cost items are loaded for this catalogue yet. Load a regional cost base first.
match.hint.no_good_match: No confident match found. Try fewer words, the material name on its own, or the description in another language.
match.reason.action_conflict: The declared work differs (e.g. demolition vs installation), which lowers confidence.
match.reason.action_match: The declared work (e.g. supply and installation) agrees.
match.reason.candidate_extra_spec: The suggested item is more specific than the bill line - extra qualifiers need a review.
match.reason.exact_match: Exact match on the normalized description.
match.reason.no_content_overlap: No content words matched - this row is not considered evidence.
match.reason.partial_overlap: Some search terms were found in this cost item.
match.reason.pattern_confirmed: A reviewer has previously confirmed this match pattern.
match.reason.pattern_rejected: A reviewer has previously rejected this match pattern.
match.reason.pool_divergence: The pooled prices diverge widely - the median needs review.
match.reason.pooled_median: Price is the median of several compatible corpus rows.
match.reason.price_spread: Stored corpus prices for this description already span a wide range.
match.reason.reference_price: This is a reference price, not a committed operator price - it needs review.
match.reason.scope_mismatch: The line and this item declare different scopes of work.
match.reason.spec_conflict: Declared specifications conflict (e.g. diameter or class), which lowers confidence.
match.reason.strong_overlap: Every search term was found in this cost item.
match.reason.thin_content_coverage: Only a single generic word matched - not enough to price from.
match.reason.weak_overlap: Few or no search terms matched this cost item.
match.semantic.not_installed: Semantic matching requires `pip install openconstructionerp[semantic]`. Exact-match results are shown; install the extra for fuzzy cost matching.
match.reason.domain_conflict: Cannot match: the line is {query_domain}, the offered price belongs to {candidate_domain} - different trades never price each other.
match.reason.low_semantic_similarity: The texts do not mean the same thing (low semantic similarity) - needs review.
match.reason.corpus_price_disagreement: The corpus holds conflicting prices for this exact item - a person must choose.
